messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-06-19, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-02-10, the Boreal team observed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- On 2026-06-09, the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- On 2026-03-20, on-call for the Boreal team passed from Marcus to Lena. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- As of 2026-06-04, for anything Atlas-related, page Priya Raman, not Marcus, since she has the Atlas team pager this cycle. [decision; valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-08, for anything Atlas-related, page Marcus, not Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-04-08 to 2026-06-04; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
    earlier: For anything Atlas-related, page Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-05. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman has the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns search-indexer?

message.reasoning: The indexer (search-indexer) is owned by the Boreal team as of 2026-04-01, when ownership passed from Atlas. On 2026-03-20, on-call for the Boreal team passed from Marcus to Lena. So the on-call for Boreal team is Lena.
